# Install the 'rentrez' package if you haven't already
install.packages("rentrez")

# Load the package
library(rentrez)

# Search the 'nuccore' (nucleotide) database for a specific query
search_results <- entrez_search(db="nuccore", term="photobiont", retmax=20)

# The search_results object contains the IDs of the matching records
print(search_results$ids)

# Retrieve the records using their IDs in GenBank format
records <- entrez_fetch(db="nuccore", id=search_results$ids, rettype="gb", retmode="text")

# Print the first part of the retrieved records
cat(substring(records, 1, 500))

# To work with the sequences in R, you might need another package like 'seqinr' or parse the GenBank file
# You can write the records to a file and then parse it using a dedicated package like 'genbankr'
writeLines(records, "insulin_sequences.gb")
